name: yadflow
description: Shared project memory and workflows for teams building with AI: a versioned record of plans, decisions, contracts and reviews across repos, human-approved review gates, and a zero-dependency `yad` CLI plus 38 skills for your AI assistant.
author: AbdelRahman Nasr

scripts.test: node --test cli/test.mjs cli/test-checks.mjs cli/test-threads.mjs cli/test-golden.mjs cli/test-migrate.mjs cli/test-hooks.mjs cli/test-detect.mjs cli/test-members.mjs cli/test-standup.mjs cli/test-lifecycle.mjs cli/test-fuzz.js
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude='cli/test*.mjs' --test-coverage-exclude='cli/test*.js' --test-coverage-lines=70 --test-coverage-branches=70 cli/test.mjs cli/test-checks.mjs cli/test-threads.mjs cli/test-golden.mjs cli/test-migrate.mjs cli/test-hooks.mjs cli/test-detect.mjs cli/test-members.mjs cli/test-standup.mjs cli/test-lifecycle.mjs cli/test-fuzz.js
scripts.diagrams: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.15.0 -i docs/diagrams/sdlc-overview.mmd -o docs/diagrams/sdlc-overview.svg -b transparent && npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.15.0 -i docs/diagrams/review-loop.mmd -o docs/diagrams/review-loop.svg -b transparent && npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.15.0 -i docs/diagrams/work-and-memory.mmd -o docs/diagrams/work-and-memory.svg -b transparent && npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.15.0 -i docs/diagrams/feature-evolution.mmd -o docs/diagrams/feature-evolution.svg -b transparent
